now.title: Blade: The Series

evidence: The record covers the two-part pilot (episodes 1-2): Krista is turned and goes undercover. Marcus unleashes his weapon against the purebloods only in the series finale (episode 13, 'Conclave'), so the Conclave Massacre report does not match this record.
